The '''''Rainhawk''-class transport''', also known as the '''Pantoran cruiser''', was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] model used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] owned one such vessel, dubbed the [[Falfa/Legends|''Falfa'']].
